in_hebrew.name: Isaian
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is gracious
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Isaian הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Isaian is derived from the Hebrew word 'Yesha' meaning 'God is gracious' or 'God saves'. In the Bible, several figures with this name are mentioned, including a prophet and a descendant of King David.

in_greek.name: Isaian
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God is gracious
in_greek.long_meaning: Isaian είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. The name Isaian is derived from the Hebrew word 'Yesha' meaning 'God is gracious' or 'God saves'. In the Bible, several figures with this name are mentioned, including a prophet and a descendant of King David.

in_latin.name: Isaianus
in_latin.meaning: derived from Isaiah, meaning God is salvation or savior
in_latin.long_meaning: Isaianus, a diminutive form of Isaiah, denoting God is salvation or savior; a name derived from the Hebrew name Yeshayahu, meaning God is salvation, or the Greek variant Îsaiás, meaning savior or deliverer; in Christian tradition, this name signifies the hope of redemption and salvation through faith in Jesus Christ; it is a name associated with the prophet Isaiah, who foretold the coming of the Messiah and the salvation of humanity
